name: loom-code
description: Use the moment you are about to grep, glob, or open files to answer a question about a loom-indexed codebase — "where is X", "how does X work", "who calls Y", "is it safe to change Z", "what does this stack trace touch". The tell is linguistic: if you just thought "let me search the codebase", "let me grep for that", or "let me read a few files", that sentence is the trigger — code.grep covers exact literals too. NOT for repos loom hasn't indexed (a code.search that abstains on everything is the tell), and NOT for your own uncommitted files (grep those; pass your diff to code.impact for blast radius).
